rationale: Record test-registration lines that cross design-source-ingest through test/cmake/design_import_tool_cli_tests.cmake: pulp_test_data(... NO_DEFINE ...) declarations for pulp-test-cli-import-design (three import fixture sets) and pulp-test-import-design-tool (tools/import-design and the .fig fixture). The two suites now run against an isolated empty PULP_HOME (test/support/isolated_pulp_home.hpp), so a host's import-design defaults cannot change what the CLI and the import tool emit under test. Import tool code, capture, rendering, DesignIR, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
